decision: Finish the semantic mapping review and four historical snapshots for every qualifying airport. No model training, feature-bundle creation, prediction edit or submission in this audit.

geometry.historical_policy: Fetch historical LFPG snapshots only if the explicit-node review clears the original 50% current-row gate. LIRF already qualified under the original declaration. Preserve source receipts from either declaration and all original reports.
geometry.parking_way_inclusion: Include non-area, non-closed parking-position lead-in ways containing an unambiguously named parking node. Use actual shared OSM nodes only. These add a geometric connection, not directed operational clearance.
geometry.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors via public Overpass API
geometry.route_proxy: Undirected mapped taxiway/taxilane plus explicitly linked parking lead-in connectivity to any shared-node access for the recorded runway; runway traversal remains excluded. Geometric lower bound only.
geometry.stand_matching: Keep exact whole-ref matching. A parking-position way and same-ref parking node are one location only when the actual node ID occurs in that way. Use that node coordinate, not the lead-in way centroid. Unlinked objects retain the original 30m ambiguity check. No geometric-nearness aliases or passenger-gate substitution.

prior_information: The initial current-map check gives LFPG 35.93% and LIRF 81.20% unambiguous parking coverage. Inspection of four rejected refs per airport shows named parking nodes contained in same-ref parking-position ways; their way-centroid differences caused false ambiguity. No model scores or hidden labels motivated this review.
purpose: Explicit node/way identity reconciliation in the label-free airport geometry study; preserve the initial strict centroid report.

source_audit.interpretation: Raw clock/label relationships on common fitting rows, not v7 prediction errors. Recurrence across months does not establish prediction improvement. No per-ID rule or broader schedule gate is selected.

user_authorization: User approved proceeding with the proposed reporting audit and small geometry coverage study after the v7 gain review.
